text: For quarterly filing larger private fund advisers, the SEC substantially overestimated the cost of subsequent Form PF filings; the survey's estimate is roughly half of what the SEC projected.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

isBasedOn.name: Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: With regards to quarterly filing larger private fund advisers, however, the SEC appears to be substantially overestimating the cost of subsequent Form PF filings.
